payload.outcome: Resolved by an explicit 2026-08-23 owner decision: preserve two purpose-specific Favourites surfaces rather than force visual equality. The dashboard FavouritesHub is the compact browse hub and retains ModeHomeHero; /favourites is the full standalone command library and starts at its single workspace h1 so filters and saved-item controls remain above fold. Both still share sharedHomePresentation.favourites identity copy and composer geometry. The decision is now recorded beside both owners in src/components/clinical-dashboard/favourites-hub.tsx and favourites-command-library-page.tsx and pinned by tests/search-route-ownership.test.ts, which asserts the compact hub keeps ModeHomeHero while the standalone workspace does not. Focused verification: npm run test -- tests/search-route-ownership.test.ts passed 1 file and 22 tests on 2026-08-23. This supersedes the cancelled premature closure a1495b3e-29fb-489a-a261-df3dcb142f51, which relied on route topology without pinning the product decision.
